addonOwnerDeletionRecovery.finding: Deleting the native DaemonSet did not alone complete the EKS add-on owner deletion that had failed during the native outage. An explicit DeleteAddon after repair and the actual addon-deleted waiter completed that retained operation. The smoke helper now waits for owner absence rather than treating an accepted asynchronous deletion as completed cleanup.

method: Replaced only the exact owned stopped native server binary using the pinned image. Existing filesystem, control-plane database, endpoint and worker workloads retained. No deletion/finalizer bypass.
